reviews.title: 2 Round trips All on Time
reviews.text: Two return trips (JUNE 2022 & 2023) each leg was punctual. Cabing crew were charming and efficient. Read poor reviews elsewhere but that is not our experience. No inflight entettainment but wo cares
reviews.author: Every6to8weeks

reviews.title: Nothing negative
reviews.text: After reading all negative reviews I was wondering what would happen during my experience with Enter air. Nothing negative from my side. Friendly staff, enough choice of drinks and food. So for an budget air company this is what you can and might expect. Would choose them again next time.
reviews.author: Peter V

reviews.title: Enter air staff
reviews.text: I flew from Stuttgart to Pristina yesterday, the staff was beyond rude, the people who flew were treated inhumanely just because the people didn't know how to speak English. It is very bad at this time to still have this kind of behavior. I personally will never fly with this kind of staff even if the ticket is 1€, I am sure that many people are of the same opinion as me.
reviews.author: Erza D

reviews.title: Enter air  the company not to use .
reviews.text: Delay of over 3 hours to our destination in January. They tried to fob us off with £100 compensation. When the Montreal conventikn clearly states £350.They are no longer replying to my emails. I guess they just hope people will give up and allow them to keep running a poor quality airline. I would reccomend paying more to change flights .I should have read the reviews before my flight .Lots of people saying the same things. The company doesnt want to know once its got your money.
reviews.author: Cruiser294873

reviews.title: Worst flight flown yet
reviews.text: Take Off and Landing was terrible. Airplanes seem to be very old, noisy and unstable. The plane was not clean at all. In general the staff seems to be unprofessional.
reviews.author: Garry B

reviews.title: Great flight - well done Enter Air crew
reviews.text: Everything great. Flights from and to Fuerteventura from Katowice both on time. Kind and nice cabin crew, professional. Thank you
reviews.author: Ivan

reviews.title: IMO The Cowboy Builders of the Airline Industry
reviews.text: Enter Air, The Cowboy Builders of the Airline Industry? Following a flight from Skiathos to Gatwick in September we waited 2 hours after our fellow passengers had received the luggage but our suitcases never appeared. We later found out that Enter Air had not loaded the cases due to the weather (it was warm and sunny!) but hadn’t bothered to tell us before we left the plane. 6 days later our 2 suitcases were delivered to us (drop and run, no time for inspection), both suitcases had been tampered with and one had the padlock ripped from the case, damaging the zip and making future locking impossible. The contents had been taken out and thrown back in but nothing was missing, in what was clearly an attempt to find valuable items. An obvious claim for damage compensation, we assumed, and sent the relevant forms and photos to Enter Air. 30 days later: Your claim for a new suitcase cannot be accepted because you did not fill in a damaged luggage form before leaving the airport. I replied that this was clearly not possible as Enter Air had the cases for 6 days after we left the airport and arranged delivery to my home. 30 days later: You must provide all of the documents and photos again, and provide purchase receipt and date of purchase for the damaged case. I replied that the case was in good condition, before they had it, but not new so I had no purchase date or receipt. 30 days later: We need more photos of the damage (how many different pictures of a damaged zip can you take!) and pictures of the back of the luggage tags, which we have now provided. They also bizarrely asked for confirmation that we had received he baggage from the courier - if we hadn’t then we wouldn’t be claiming for damage! My advice to anyone flying anywhere is to not use Enter Air is don’t! We booked through Ionian Island Holidays, a reputable company we have used for years and always provided an excellent flight and accommodation. We will use Ionian again, but only if they do not use this appallingly poor airline. In my opinion they are the cowboy builders of the Airline Industry.
reviews.author: Pete Christie

reviews.title: Pleasingly satisfactory despite the other reviews
reviews.text: Flew with EnterAir to Finland on26th February. Didnt know quite what to expect after the recent reviews. In fact all was fine. Plane (elderly according to Flightradar) was clean with seating a little better than is normal with budget airlines. Crew were also as friendly as you might expect in this category. If anything the flightdeck were more communicative than normal, giving us plenty of information on the anticipated "chop" on the return flight. Both flights were on time and trolley service en route was without problems. However, we did not experience any external issues such as delays, diversions, overweight aircraft or luggage being left behind which might suggest EnterAir are as good as or similar to other budget airlines when all is normal, but that they have difficulty managing when other factors intervene.
reviews.author: casahistoria

reviews.title: Avoid the airline if possible
reviews.text: Pathetic, unprofessional, provincial line. Avoid if you can. They take long-haul flights without having the right plane. Cramped seats, a stopover in Egypt was needed to refuel the plane (almost an hour's break). I was flying at night and couldn't sleep. Approx. time. At 1am I was woken up by a stewardess who was selling some perfume to another passenger and loudly praising it. Approx. time. 2 a.m. break for refueling (then they turn on the lights and talk loudly through the loudspeakers about stopping, refueling, etc.) Approx. time. At 3:30 am, another stewardess started selling perfumes, cigarettes, etc. crap. To my comment that she could wait with the sale until the morning and now let the passengers sleep, she replied that this is the procedure. I'm at a loss for words.
reviews.author: Olek

reviews.title: Mrs Sandra Tilson.
reviews.text: We flew with enterair Sunday 22nd January 2023. There was no water on the plane for hot drinks no water it the toilet it was pretty grim then coming back on the 26th January 2023 and they ran out of sandwiches we hope we never come across the airline ever again.
reviews.author: Sandra T

reviews.title: Awful airline. Makes the budget airlines look like first class.
reviews.text: Simply awful. On departure we were told there would be no drinks served on board, even water. Cabin crew insisted my elderly grandma wait for assistance that we were not expecting, which never came, putting us at the back of the passport control queue which made our journey very difficult and no apology given for their mistake. On the return journey delayed with no communication and cabin crew on board were extremely rude, curt, disinterested and unhelpful. Looked and acted like they didn't want to be in those jobs at all. On the return journey my 91 year old grandma was directed to the stairs at the back of the plane, when we got outside the cabin we could see a ramp had been brought to the front of the plane but it was too late. The staff said nothing. Our brand new suitcases (and the luggage of many other passengers) was badly damaged. Wheels smashed off, huge rips in fabric, handles broken etc. Looking at these reviews my experience was very similar to others.
reviews.author: Georgia Louise

reviews.title: Worst Airline I have ever flown with.
reviews.text: We booked our holiday through the tour operator Transun so did not know what airline would be used until the very last minute and I had never heard of Enter Air previously. The flight out was delayed by over 3 hours and no vouchers or support was given at the airport. When we finally boarded there were no free refreshments other than one cheap juice drink from a carton. The cabin crew then proceeded to provide the slowest cart service I have ever experienced, to make matters worse they started this service from either end of the gangway so being sat in the centre aisle we could not use the toilet facilities at all as there was no way to get around the carts and it took literally hours. Additionally, by the time they reached us there were no vegetarian sandwiches left so we had to go hungry, cabin crew were not in the slightest bit apologetic regarding this. The return flight was a complete disaster as they removed 29 suitcases from the flight (all of ours included) and told no one. This was done at the captain's command and we were told by Exeter ground crew that the flight was overweight. I'm not sure why this would occur as there were 2 empty seats on the return journey and nowhere to go shopping so I doubt people were bringing much more back than they took with them. The key thing for me was the lack of information as I can understand they may have not wanted to tell us before we landed it would have been good customer care to have someone to explain things once we arrived, instead we were left waiting at the carousel for bags that were still in Finland as the crew walked past with all their cases ignoring everyone. The next flight from ENT was on Sunday so we had to wait another 3 days for our bags to be in the country and they were dropped a 6-hour drive away at Teesside airport. Enter Air did not inform the ground crew where the bags were destined for so they just sat at Teeside airport for a further 2 days. It was only fortunate that we had Apple air tags and knew where they were to phone up and request they get sent down to Exeter. The staff at Teesside were lovely and helpful and got them on their way pretty much immediately once they knew. Exeter staff have equally been brilliant and the bags are currently being couriered back to us today. Never again will I fly Enter Air or book with Transun who provided zero support.
reviews.author: Zaly21

reviews.title: Enter air but your baggage won't.
reviews.text: If your flight is with Enter Air get it changed now. Flight was delayed by 3.5 hrs and was told that we would be looked after on the flight. (Free food & drink) okay we got a free apple juice but we ended up having to pay extortionate prices for food as they didn't give us anything. £20 for 2 drinks, 2 sandwiches and 2 small pots of pringles. I get it was busy and the flight attendants had to be braught in on another plane from somewhere else but they where quite rude. The worst of it though was we got back after an amazing holiday to find that our bags plus 27 others had been taken off the plane under the captains orders and left behind in Finland. No communication was made prior, during or even after we had landed we only found out once our bags never came out the conveyer. Piss poor service from this Airline will be getting a few emails from me regarding compensation for now though i just prey our baggage turns up in the next week or so.
reviews.author: simon

reviews.title: Delayed 9 hrs, no communication, no compensation. They have even disregarded the Civil Aviation Authority
reviews.text: Booked through Kaboodle for Hideout festival. The festival was great when we eventually got there however due to a 9 hr delay we lost a day of the festival. Enter Air communication in the airport was minimal. On our return we applied for compensation which they declined, contacted the Civil Aviation Authority who upheld our claim but Enter Air still refused to pay compensation. Now have to take it to court. Never fly with this company, they don’t play by the rules. Rubbish customer service.
reviews.author: Caitlin

reviews.title: Still waiting for my delayed flight compensation - travelled June 2022
reviews.text: I have never had to write a review on trip advisor before but I am appalled at this airline Enter Air - unhelpful at LGW - really rude on board flight and then tried to fob me off with a 50 euro compensation settlement before getting off the plane that was 3.5 hours late arriving - still trying to get the 400 euros I am entitled to out of this airline - the worst thing being that a reputable activity holiday company called Neilsons continues to use them and will not assist their guests in the compensation claim process.
reviews.author: Sharon Y

reviews.title: WORST airline EVER
reviews.text: Enterair left us stranded at a diverted airport for several hours without booking forward travel or coaches. As a result we paid for our own travel home costing £900. After several ignored emails over many weeks they still have not responded. Their website complaints system will not process a complaint. I have videos to prove. I am reporting you to the U.K. civil Aviation Authority
reviews.author: s12342

reviews.title: Worst Airline EVER!!
reviews.text: This was the worst flight experience of our lives! The cabin crew were the rudest we have ever come across. They would not even accommodate water for my 6 year old who woke up thirsty. It wouldn't have been an issue if there had been a drinks service but they stopped 3 rows short of us! The food was a choice of dry ham or cheese sandwich. Would never fly with them again.
reviews.author: chibi123

reviews.title: Service with a Smile ? (NOOOO)
reviews.text: A memorable flight (both there and back), but for the wrong reasons. I'm fact, it turned into a great topic of conversation between passengers, especially on the way home, who had travelled together on the way to Finland. It doesn't happen twice right ? To keep it simple, the cabin crew were 'one of a kind', in terms of customer service, helpfulness and friendliness. From stomping up and down the isle, making passengers quiver in their seats if they dare to ask for anything or press their bell, to literally being ignored or felt like they were a nuisance. Come on Enter Air, do better with your cabin crew to at least try and smile and be courteous to your paying passengers and read the reviews on your staff, who, in the most part, cold, aloof, clearly miserable and at points aggressive in their tone.
reviews.author: Theresa

reviews.title: Don't expect any help from EnterAir
reviews.text: After I had checked in my luggage in Chania Airport in the afternoon the 19. August, goods to the prize of 156 euros were stolen from my luggage. The only possible scenario is that the person scanning my suitcase has spotted the goods and has marked the suitcase so that coworkers could steal the goods on the way to the plane. Within days I filed a complaint to both the greek police an to the airline by mail. The Greek police is the most corrupt in the EU, so it was only a minor surprise that they did not react. However, EnterAir deliberately made it practically impossible to file a complaint over robbed luggage. Instead of informing me that I should get a PIR document in the airport within a week, they just sent me a useless standard mail saying that I should use a form on their homepage, eventhough there are no forms about stolen goods!!! If EnterAir had just cared a little bit about their customers, they could have secured the scannings from Chania Airport - these are kept for a month. Don't fly with EnterAir - they don't care about you.
reviews.author: Stig J

reviews.title: Terrible service
reviews.text: Terrible service in case of luggage get damaged by airport service. If any problem occurs during Your fly Enter air will not support You. They have really poor standards.
reviews.author: P S

reviews.title: Dodgy
reviews.text: This was the dodgiest airline I have ever flew with. I am not sure what service my company paid for, but we got a MUFFIN to eat and soft drink and water to drink. The plane looked old and cheaply maintained.
reviews.author: gy.a.

reviews.title: Lost luggage - terrible customer service
reviews.text: Flew from Skiathos to Gatwick and told that 80 suitcases did not make it on board. 2 months later we have tried all avenues and still no luggage. No customer service contact details, no contact from the airline. Would like to understand if Enter Air can be reported for accepting no accountability or making no attempt to find lost luggage
reviews.author: Emily D

reviews.title: Very smooth operation
reviews.text: Check in at Gatwick was quick and efficient. Crew on plane were very polite and helpful. Not having on line booking worked in passengers favour, seats allocated at check thus all passengers are in the same category. I find priority booking or speedy booking makes passengers feel they are in competition with each other, so pleased Enter Air do not operate in this way.
reviews.author: MikeTn39

reviews.title: Dreadful customer service
reviews.text: Unfortunately the good (clean, on time, good leg room) vastly outweighed by the bad. Bags not loaded on the flight home to allow for more fuel, no one bothered to tell us, waited pointlessly at Gatwick to collect, no ability to call airline and no one bothers to reply to email. Totally left to sort it out ourselves. Zero customer service. Will not use again nor take a holiday with anyone who uses them in a package.
reviews.author: Richard L

reviews.title: Can only review as I found
reviews.text: I’ve seen the horrendous reviews and was concerned, but flew return London to Lemnos in Sept 2022 and found cabin crew (different each way) were friendly and helpful. And the landings were excellent each way. So no complaints at all. We were on a Mark Warner charter.
reviews.author: mick1802

reviews.title: Wedding luggage lost
reviews.text: We had guests fly with enter air. Their luggage was lost (never made it on the plane). It has now been over a week and there has been no communication about the luggage or how they will fix this. Terrible service. Would have put a 0 as to recommendation but it wasn’t an option.
reviews.author: Maisie P

reviews.title: Lost Baggage. Impossible to contact
reviews.text: As far as I can tell your airline is a joke. You should lose your license to operate. 80 suitcases left in Greece. We then stand in line to file a report for two hours in london. 5 days later no contact from the airline. I call the number in global Baggage Services and they say they do not work with enter Air and to contact enter directly. So what was the point in registering this in Gatwick??? Emailed your customer services and it seems little will be done. Fill out a claim form. Reading the terms your compensation is pathetic and will never cover the cost of everything. It’s a disgrace. Cowboys. My wedding suit that cost a fortune and my finest clothes gone. Enter Air is a joke Here’s what any reputable airline should have done - contacted us after the weekend to confirm you have the luggage and you are making arrangements to ship it. It’s not hard. Your job is to get passengers and their belongings from A to B. It’s the very basic tenant of being an airline. You have a responsibility to find it It is totally and utterly unacceptable that you have not contacted me. I will instruct my lawyers if something doesn’t happen. I want my wedding clothes back!!!! Makes for a great tabloid headline. Airline loses wedding clothes. Suggest you take the data from my name. Find my email and find my suitcases!!!
reviews.author: Ben T

reviews.title: Or do not Enter
reviews.text: Let’s start with a positive, despite all the recent problems with airports and carriers, the flight was, more or less, on time. BUT, if you like travel of a friendly, welcoming nature with smiling crew offering a helpful, welcoming service in up to date aircraft then look elsewhere for your flight. I have never, in many years of travelling, encountered such a surly, hostile downright rude approach to customer care based clearly upon the approach that you’re a blessed nuisance, sit down and be quiet. My granddaughter of 20 was told very aggressively to ‘get out’ whilst awaiting access to the toilet. Recruitment for this Polish airline is clearly hampered and the charm element of the job not a consideration. The onboard refreshments were very limited, even water being charged for and there was no ice as there was no refrigeration on board. Apparently. As this flight was part of a package with a very expensive and faultless villa rental company we will be sure to book our flights separately in future. In summary, DO NOT ENTER
reviews.author: Gaggy2013

reviews.title: Worst flight experience i’ve had!
reviews.text: Definitely would NOT recommend- Absolutely shocking! Flight was delayed by 9 hours which left myself & my friends travelling for over 20 hours. Once on board the plane we were then left sat there for 1 hour and 30 minutes with no communication from cabin crew/pilot explaining the reason for the delay. The cabin crew were very unapproachable and rude making myself & my friends very uncomfortable. Whilst away we were emailed & told that we were entitled to a refund of £350 EACH due to the delay, after sending all details which were needed (boarding pass, flight number, personal details etc) i received a letter back to say that i would not be receiving any kind of refund whatsoever! Definitely will not be flying with this airline at any point again in the future.
reviews.author: Amy T

reviews.title: Flight delayed, lost a day on holiday with no compensation
reviews.text: I flew with Enter Air on the 2nd July. The flight was set to depart at 06:55, we did not depart until 2pm due to a delay. Correspondence regarding why the flight was delayed was terrible. We received an airport voucher & were given a form to claim compensation for the delay which required us to enclose the boarding pass & flight tickets. I sent the required form over 6 weeks ago and have had no correspondence since. In that time I contacted the company we booked the flights/package with as it was a festival and they advised me to contact Enter Air. I completed another form on Enter Air’s website asking where the response/compensation was and still no reply. Today I have lodged a complaint and as they don’t appear to be on the Alternative Dispute Resolution body, I will be taking this further to the Civil Aviation Authority. I am disappointed with the lack of response and waiting for compensation. I lost a full day of my holiday due to this. Would not recommend Enter Air to anyone!!
reviews.author: Ashlee B

reviews.title: Will not fly with EnterAir again
reviews.text: Our flight out to Croatia on 2nd July 2022 from Manchester was firstly met with nobody to check us in as they ‘forgot’ for us then to be told that our plane was still in Paris and that another was having to be flown in from Warsaw. We was suppose to fly at 6:55 in the morning, the new flight we was told should be boarding at 12:30pm we was then told this plane then had technical difficulties. We did not board until 3pm with no explanation. 7hours and 30 minutes after we was suppose to fly we eventually boarded. We was then told no food or drink would be served on the flight. The plane was dirty, the staff was no help. I have now been trying to get in contact with this airline for the past 7 weeks and have still no reply from them. Would not fly with this joke of an airline again.
reviews.author: Beth

reviews.title: Delayed over 10 Hours - Will not compensate
reviews.text: We were delayed over 10 hours on a chartered flight provided by Enter Air, I wrote a letter with all requested documentation provided to make a reasonable claim. Unfortunately it cost us a lot of money to sit in the Airport for 10+ Hours on food and drink with not so much as an apology provided. No trolly service provided throughout the flight, we couldn’t even get so much as a bottle of water. Terribly rude staff, awful airline…Avoid at all costs!! Absolutely Disgusting
reviews.author: emily123

reviews.title: No water. Scary landing.
reviews.text: Booked a package holiday so no choice of airline. Check-in was seamless and staff friendly and efficient. Plane clean and as expected. Flight delayed by 40 mins - no fault of airline - but sat on tarmac and got very hot. Cabin crew stayed in the galley and offered no water to passengers. After takeoff lots of people asked for water, but were told 'wait until we start serving drinks'. This despite there being dozens of bottles of water in the overhead lockers, presumably for the crew themselves. When they started serving, anyone who asked for free water was told they had to buy a 500ml bottle for €3. No water would be given out. This left several children quite distressed. I questioned a crew member but either her English wasn't adequate or she pretended to not understand. Also, they only had a couple of things listed on the already limited menu and drinks were warm - no ice available. Service complete, crew members got big bottles of water out of the overhead lockers and enjoyed a long drink! Finally, the landing at Corfu was very violent - pilot's first time? The plane dropped to the ground with a thump so heavy that most people screamed or cried out, then the plane swerved violently before the pilot got control. Not a great experience!
reviews.author: Scared passenger

reviews.title: Enter Air - no complaints here just a delayed departure...
reviews.text: After reading all the terrible reviews we were a bit worried about our flight! Overall it was absolutely fine, the plane was clean, plenty of legroom, pleasant staff. No complaints really. The plane was late leaving and the boarding was slow followed by a very long bus ride I thought we were going to the other terminal! We had then missed our take off slot so had a long wait for a take off slot! Other flights around us were being cancelled due to mechanical issues etc so we were just please our flight was still going! Anyway all good with Enter Air for us I've had much worse flights with B.A. so don't fear!!
reviews.author: E135952

reviews.title: A shame !!!
reviews.text: Thanks for this beginning of travel Enter Air ! You lose my bag OK, but 0 answer after 4 mails to alert about this mistake. You can write a mail to apologize no ? I had some spent because you have lost my bag and you don't care. I was my first and last Time with this company
reviews.author: Stan C

reviews.title: A good standard and on time
reviews.text: It was a charter flight from Warsaw, Poland to Tirana, Albania. The flight was on time, no delays. Everything was as it should be. We had a chance to flight Boeing 737 Max, which is a nice airplane.
reviews.author: 73Marco

reviews.title: If you have an option, chose another company!
reviews.text: Awful service.2 hours Delayed flight because the crew was waiting for food delivery for the board. The worst experience ever. Don’t recommend
reviews.author: Nataliia T
reviews.route: Basel - Las Palmas de Gran Canaria

reviews.title: Decent Flight but food poor
reviews.text: Flight delayed 2 hours but all down to Gatwick and not the airline. Flight ok decent legroom but don’t expect the available food to match what’s on the menu. £5.50 for a dry white bread roll, zero butter and plastic looking cheese not acceptable.
reviews.author: The Fonz

reviews.title: Very Poor Soft Product/Cabin Crew
reviews.text: Outbound ENT 447 LGW-RHO 14.05.22 Check in was a fiasco. We asked for seats NOT on the wing, confirmed that our seats were not on the wing and of course the seats were directly on the wing. Cabin crew attitude and service was very poor. Their expressions ranged from disinterested, fed-up and bored. The captain and crew spoke with very thick accents and most passengers struggled to understand them. Flight was delayed by approx 1hr 30 mins and most of that time was spent onboard at the stand. Finally, a FA announced delay was due to late arrival of passengers. It seems the gate was closed when the passengers arrived late to board and ground crew turned them away. The captain of the flight intervened. During this 'altercation', we missed our departure slot. The flight service was extremely poor. A FA told us that only twenty sandwiches had been loaded, there was no ice, none of the drinks were cold. There were many young families on board who were clearly not happy. Inbound ENT 448 RHO-LGW 21.05.22 The cabin crew was far worse on this leg. They were unfriendly and rude, in particular the female FA serving with male colleague from the back of the aircraft. My seat was filthy and I had to wipe it down before I could sit. At the gate in Rhodes, we requested assistance for arrival at LGW. We sat on the plane for 30 mins after landing and no assistance arrived. Overall, the Enter Air experience was unpleasant and at times intimidating driven by the attitude and demeanour of the cabin crew. Enter Air is providing chartered flights to Rhodes for Mark Warner, which in our opinion is badly detracting from the Mark Warner package/offering.
reviews.author: jenm2016

reviews.title: Don't recomment
reviews.text: Flight was delayed on both ways with 1.5 h. Airplane was very dirty from inside, Toilet was disgustingly dirty. staff members werent very professional. Nobody were using marks not even the staff (their website is says it's mandatonry.)
reviews.author: Lana I

reviews.title: Very bad
reviews.text: Smells like poop staff is ugly with yo much Botox thought the airplane was going to collapse when we took off no food it was very noisy and looked cheap and everything was broken
reviews.author: Don’t fly with enter air

reviews.title: Excellent service from on board staff
reviews.text: Great experience flying with Enter Air. Staff friendly, polite and courteous. Shame about UK passengers who left rubbish in the seat area and floor. Despite Gatwick airport delays to disembark passengers Enter Air staff remained calm, courteous and professional
reviews.author: Angela O

reviews.title: DO NOT FLY with enter air.
reviews.text: Dreadful from start to finish. Awful rude check in staff at both airports. Broke my bike box and ignoring all my attempts to contact for compensation. NEVER AGAIN!!!!!!
reviews.author: Stephen C

reviews.title: I got covid on this flight
reviews.text: In total the flight was a terrible experience. The only airline I flew, where noone had to wear masks, not even the cabin crew. With lots of people sneezing and coughing that made me feel really uncomfortable. It was an overnight fligt so I hoped to get some sleep, but that was not possible, as people in the plane where drinking and shouting all night while getting completely wasted. 3 days after getting home i tested positive on corona. Without having close contact to anybody else the days before and after the flight, I am sure i got it in the plane.
reviews.author: Florian M

reviews.title: Don't believe all the bad reviews
reviews.text: Unlike as mentioned is some other reviews, there was more than enough legroom (as much as any other budget airline I've flown with). The cabin crew were all very pleasant. Can't comment on the food as didn't have any. Drinks service was fine - even though this was for a rugby trip they didn't run out of beer!! Overall, very pleased with them.
reviews.author: kpiokl

reviews.title: 'Go around' landing made the heart race after a weekend at the rugby
reviews.text: Left Rome late as nobody to push the plane back. Buses out to aircraft. A little bit of turbulence over the Alps. Weather at Birmingham pretty good. Cold but minimal wind. A few feet off the ground the pilot performed a go around. This happens apparently on 1-3 flights in every 1000 and can be dangerous. God knows why but was really frightening. I'm a reasonably good flyer but my wife was in tears. No explanation from the crew. A guy near us said he (the pilot) got the approach totally wrong and could have had us on the grass. Whatever I've never experienced anything like it. Don't think I'll be using Enter Air again
reviews.author: Chris S

reviews.title: Bike box broken and they now just ignore us!
reviews.text: Awful airline. We booked bikes on the flight but they were trying to make us pay again even though I already had through mark warner. When we finally sorted this out with them they charged us for being 2kg overweight on one bag. Even though other bag underweight. Really rude member of staff and she was determined we’d pay for something I think. Maybe they are on commission for this! On arrival the bike box was broken and clearly thrown from a great height. Bike remarkably ok but left the question of how we get it home again?!? Been trying to get payment from them for the bike box since September. They don’t respond to letters emails phone calls etc. Mickey Mouse airline AVOID if you can.
reviews.author: Chicken2000

reviews.title: What An Experience
reviews.text: Flight left on time, but I am so glad I had a breakfast before departure, the food was not good. a hash brown, 4 tiny mushrooms and bake beans that had been overheated and no bean juice. Could not hear the announcements. Staff were very friendly though. Delayed by 2hrs on the way back with no explanation. Food back was a cheese and pickle sandwich. Would I fly with them again, probably as it was not long haul I can cope with bad food as next time I will take my own. But that is not the point. I guess they assume you will only go to Lapland once so it does not matter - oh but it does!!!
reviews.author: Angela Strsw

reviews.title: Worst airline I have ever used!
reviews.text: Nothing good to say about their whole process! Service was poor and both flights ran late with no explanation
reviews.author: travelloverLeicester

reviews.title: Dirty old plane. Cocky and tense cabin crew.
reviews.text: Flying with enter air takes all the magic of well deserved holidays away. It was not a first time I used this airline but will definately avoid it in the future. Their planes seem old, not cleaned well enough. I'm not an expert but the machine looked 25-30 years old to me. The cabin crew is simply not good enough. They appear as professional but create tense and unfriendly atmosphere. Cocky attitude of the cabin crew is saddening. The food is nice and they are normally on time. Altogether poor quality experience.
reviews.author: Michal Z
